name.en: Fio Puro Black Leather Biker Jacket with Asymmetric Zip, Notched Lapels, Zip Pockets and Cropped Regular Fit
name.pt-BR: Jaqueta Biker Fio Puro Preta em Couro com Zíper Assimétrico, Lapelas, Bolsos com Zíper e Caimento Reto Curto

description.en: A streamlined biker jacket in supple leather with an asymmetric closure, notched lapels and zipped pockets. The clean hardware keeps the classic shape easy to dress up or down.
description.pt-BR: Jaqueta biker de couro macio com fechamento assimétrico, lapelas e bolsos com zíper. As ferragens discretas deixam o formato clássico fácil de combinar em diferentes ocasiões.
